automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.policy: Include only public sources with a visible publication or update date strictly inside the two-day window. Date-only candidates at the lower boundary are excluded.

wiki_coverage_checked.federation_decision: The upstream AI wiki owns broad companies, products, models, developer tools, agentic frameworks, MCP servers, and technique background. This artifact retains only local practice implications.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Agentic Workflows documents a scheduled issue-to-coding-agent workflow that pauses when draft-PR capacity is reached, no candidate issue exists, required checks are failing, or rate-limit signals appear. Its audited run used narrowly scoped comment and assignment outputs through a single safe-output surface.
qualifying_updates.practice_implication: Treat autonomous backlog dispatch as a bounded queue: prepare a short candidate set, cap concurrent agent work, require healthy prerequisite checks, and restrict agent writes to explicitly allowed output actions. Preserve run evidence so anomalous turns, prompts, or tool breadth can be reviewed.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing_note: Do not create a local product or MCP-server page. The downstream candidate is a workflow-pattern synthesis about admission gates, bounded write actions, and run evidence.

qualifying_updates.source_title: Redesign how your team ships software with AI agents
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitLab frames AI-native engineering as redesigning delivery flow, not merely accelerating code generation. It identifies undocumented standards, difficult-to-start environments, and person-held context as delivery stalls, and calls for explicit human-control, review, security-check, and release-approval decisions.
qualifying_updates.practice_implication: Measure whether review and verification capacity can absorb agent-generated change volume before increasing autonomy. Make standards, environment setup, context sources, approval ownership, and release evidence explicit; otherwise faster code generation merely moves the bottleneck downstream.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing_note: GitLab product and company facts belong upstream. The local candidate is an adoption-and-operating-model lens for verification capacity and documented control points.

qualifying_updates.source_title: Neo4j Context Engine Launches to Create AI Knowledge Layer and Enhance Agent Performance
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Neo4j announced a context-engine product positioned as a reusable shared knowledge layer for agents and as a configuration point for agents, MCP servers, and developer tools. The source is a product announcement, not an independent efficacy evaluation.
qualifying_updates.practice_implication: When several agent surfaces use organizational knowledge, define a governed shared semantic layer with accountable sources, access boundaries, and refresh rules instead of copying opaque context into each prompt or tool configuration. Validate retrieval provenance and authorization independently of the vendor claim.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing_note: The product, company, and MCP background are upstream-owned. Retain only the downstream context-governance implication, clearly attributed as a product-positioning signal.
